groups.name: System font stack, no web fonts
groups.definition: Does the page rely only on a system or system-ui font stack (Helvetica/Arial/system sans) with no custom web or icon fonts?

groups.name: Single sans family throughout
groups.definition: Is one single sans-serif family used for all text including headings?

groups.name: Serif headings paired with sans body
groups.definition: Are headings or display text set in a serif face while body and UI text use a sans-serif?

groups.name: Serif body with sans headings
groups.definition: Is body text set in a serif while headings and UI use a sans-serif?

groups.name: Generous body size and line height
groups.definition: Is body text about 16-17px with generous line height (around 1.55-1.65)?

groups.name: Compact body line height, small h2
groups.definition: Does the page use standard 16px body text with compact line height and small h2 sizes?

groups.name: Uppercase letter-spaced eyebrow labels
groups.definition: Are there small uppercase, letter-spaced labels (eyebrows, kickers, category or footer labels) above headings or titles?

groups.name: Large bold headings with strong hierarchy
groups.definition: Are headings (h1/h2) large and bold, creating a clear size hierarchy over body text?

groups.name: Modest heading scale
groups.definition: Are h2 headings small (about 22px) rather than large?

groups.name: Light or regular weight headings
groups.definition: Are section headings set at regular or light weight rather than bold?

groups.name: Hero headline partly accent-colored
groups.definition: Is part of the hero headline highlighted in an accent color or weight different from the rest?

groups.name: White hero headline on dark background
groups.definition: Is the hero h1 large white text over a dark, image or gradient background?

groups.name: Centered headings and intro text
groups.definition: Are section headings or intro text centered?

groups.name: All-caps headings
groups.definition: Are headlines or section headings set in all uppercase?

groups.name: Headings in title or sentence case
groups.definition: Are the main headings in title or sentence case rather than all caps?

groups.name: Card titles bold, not uppercase or link-styled
groups.definition: Are card or article titles bold, left-aligned, in sentence/title case rather than uppercase, centered or default blue links?

groups.name: Hero h1 split into two sizes
groups.definition: Is the hero h1 split into a large bold line and a smaller secondary line?

groups.name: Link underline treatment
groups.definition: Are links styled without underline or with underlines limited to inline text links?

groups.name: Section titles with thick underline rule
groups.definition: Do section titles have a thick rule beneath each?

groups.name: Navigation labels small title case near logo
groups.definition: Are top navigation labels small, title case and grouped beside the logo?

groups.name: Copyright line small grey with hairline
groups.definition: Is the copyright line small, sentence case, grey with a hairline rule above?

groups.name: Prices bold green with struck-through original
groups.definition: Are prices bold and green with the original price struck through in grey?

groups.name: Excerpt and byline gray text under titles
groups.definition: Do excerpts and bylines appear in gray sans text under article titles?

groups.name: News headlines medium-weight h4
groups.definition: Are news headlines medium-weight sans-serif h4 headings?
